meta.note: Surfaces, border and ink are declared in the @theme block of src/index.css (fonts too). Zinc, blue, amber and red scales, sizes, radii, spacing and shadows are Tailwind v4.3.0 defaults of the utility classes the components use.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background (App and LoginScreen root). At 85% opacity it is the blurred loading overlay.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Cards and panels: the rounded-2xl content boxes, header bar, login card.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Inset fields and list rows inside a card; inputs on focus.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover state of rows and secondary buttons; at 75% opacity, subtle chips.

tokens.name: surface-350
tokens.usage: Hover on a single secondary control.

tokens.name: surface-400
tokens.usage: Hover for tab, filter and category buttons — the strongest neutral hover.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px border on every card, input and divider (the most used color class in the app). Also filled secondary chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default body text on surface-0 and surface-100.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, the display title, and text on blue-600 buttons and badges.

tokens.name: zinc-200
tokens.usage: Emphasized body text inside rows.

tokens.name: zinc-300
tokens.usage: Secondary text slightly quieter than ink.

tokens.name: zinc-400
tokens.usage: Muted text: descriptions, snippets, timestamps, and the small uppercase mono labels (about 7:1 on surface-0).

tokens.name: zinc-500
tokens.usage: Decorative icons in empty states and small dots, borders on quiet callouts. Not for text: about 4.0:1 on surface-0.

tokens.name: zinc-600
tokens.usage: Not used for text or icons: below 3:1 on surface-0. Reserved for disabled outlines.

tokens.name: zinc-700
tokens.usage: Stronger border for dashed or emphasized outlines.

tokens.name: zinc-800
tokens.usage: Text-selection background; filled neutral chip.

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Link or accent text on blue-950 tinted grounds.

tokens.name: blue-400
tokens.usage: Accent text on dark surfaces: 'AI insight' labels, active tab text, icons.

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: Accent borders and focus outlines; the selected-card border (also at 20–40% opacity); 10% fill for selected tint.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (buttons, the app mark, 'priority' badges) with ink-strong text.

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Hover state of blue-600 primary buttons.

tokens.name: blue-950
tokens.usage: At 20% opacity: tinted background of an AI-summary panel.

tokens.name: amber-200
tokens.usage: Text inside an amber warning panel.

tokens.name: amber-300
tokens.usage: Warning panel heading.

tokens.name: amber-400
tokens.usage: Warning icon.

tokens.name: amber-500
tokens.usage: Upcoming-meeting / live signal: the pulsing dot in the header, warning text and border; 10% fill and 20% border for the warning panel.

tokens.name: amber-950
tokens.usage: Border of the deep warning panel.

tokens.name: red-100
tokens.usage: Text in an error banner on red-950.

tokens.name: red-400
tokens.usage: Urgent / important label text; error icons.

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Urgent badge: 10% fill with 20% border and red-400 text; solid dot for unread-urgent.

tokens.name: red-900
tokens.usage: At 40% opacity: error banner border.

tokens.name: red-950
tokens.usage: At 30% opacity: error banner background.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Login screen title (text-4xl font-light tracking-tight), ink-strong.

styles.name: card-heading
styles.usage: Card headings: text-xs extrabold UPPERCASE tracking-wider, ink.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text (text-sm); leading-relaxed (1.625) for email snippets.
styles.sample: You have 3 meetings and 2 priority emails today.

styles.name: body-xs
styles.usage: The dominant UI size (text-xs): row text, descriptions.
styles.sample: Quarterly sync with the design team

styles.name: label-mono
styles.usage: Field labels and eyebrows: UPPERCASE, tracking-widest, zinc-400.

styles.name: badge-mono
styles.usage: Pill badges and category tags: UPPERCASE, tracking-wider, leading-none.

styles.name: status-mono
styles.usage: Footer status lines and IDs (font-mono text-xs).

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons and badges.

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Login card padding; section gaps.

tokens.usage: Cards and panels.
